value.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4: Identity Guidelines | PDF - Scribd
value.snippet: NIST Special Publication 800- 63B -4 provides guidelines for the authentication of individuals interacting with government information systems, detailing technical requirements for three authentication assurance levels. The document aims to ensure that claimants are properly authenticated and can assert their identity in federated identity systems. This publication supersedes the previous ...

value.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4 Digital Identity Guidelines | PDF - Scribd
value.snippet: NIST SP 800- 63B -4 is a draft guideline focused on authentication and authenticator management for digital identity systems, emphasizing the need for secure and equitable identity solutions. It outlines technical requirements for three authenticator assurance levels and incorporates feedback from a public comment period to enhance its content.
